decisions.rationale: Improved user discovery and design aesthetics consistent with Pitwall Brutalism
Dynamic shopping experience allowing live additions and removals directly from header
Dynamic layouts for product items with customizable filters and sorting

context_notes: All prep work is done. Phase 02.4 (Collections Redesign) and Phase 02.5 (Manifesto Image Reveal) are fully completed, built, and committed. Refined navigation bars and hover cart dropdown are implemented. The next step is planning Phase 3 (Helmets PDP & Dynamic Routing) on the new device.
